title: Getting Started with Next.js 15 & App Router
subtitle: A comprehensive guide to understanding Server Components, Action functions, and optimizing performance in modern web development.
description: Learn how to build modern, fast, and SEO-friendly web applications with Next.js.
author: AK Haolader

content.text: Next.js has completely transformed the frontend web development landscape. With the stabilization of the App Router, building fast, scalable, and SEO-friendly applications has become more intuitive than ever before.
Why Choose Next.js for Modern Web Apps?

The transition from client-side rendering to server-side capabilities allows applications to deliver zero-bundle-size React components by default. This significantly speeds up initial page load times and boosts Google lighthouse scores.

keyTakeaways: Server Components decrease JavaScript bundle size sent to the client.
Server Actions eliminate the need for writing manual REST API boilerplate.
Built-in Image and Font optimization out-of-the-box.

title: Mastering Tailwind CSS Best Practices
subtitle: Essential techniques to structure utility classes, manage component reuse, and maintain clean UI codebases.
description: Tips and tricks to write cleaner, reusable, and maintainable Tailwind CSS code.
author: AK Haolader

content.text: Tailwind CSS allows developers to rapidly build custom user interfaces without leaving HTML. However, without proper structure, utility-first CSS can quickly turn into messy and hard-to-maintain markup.
Leveraging Reusable Components and Helper Classes
Instead of duplicating long chains of utility classes across multiple elements, combine Tailwind with React component architecture or helper tools like `clsx` and `tailwind-merge`.
Optimizing for Dark Mode and Custom Themes

keyTakeaways: Keep components modular to prevent long utility class duplication.
Use `tailwind-merge` to handle dynamic conditional classes cleanly.

title: JWT Authentication with Node.js & Express
subtitle: Step-by-step guide to secure user routes, handle token expiration, and store JWTs safely.
description: A complete step-by-step guide to implementing secure JWT authentication in Node.js.
author: AK Haolader

content.text: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are a stateless and industry-standard method for securely transmitting information between client and server as a JSON object.
Protecting routes requires creating an Express middleware function that extracts the bearer token from HTTP headers and verifies its signature.

keyTakeaways: Store access tokens in memory or HttpOnly cookies to mitigate XSS risks.
Always set appropriate token expiration times.
Use Refresh Tokens to silently renew user access.
